COLUMN 00/32 · LEFT MARGIN
The object is the explanation. Forty-five key actions pull individual pivoting typebars with paired type slugs into the ribbon and paper. The escapement meters the carriage one character at a time. SPACE feeds without printing; RETURN releases the rack and advances the paper.
